Implemented all five `devkit/` modules in parallel, one subagent per module, then reviewed and independently verified the results.

| Module | Implementation |
| --- | --- |
| `devkit.semver` | Strict SemVer 2.0.0 parsing/canonical formatting, precedence comparison, and `||` range matching with `=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `^`, `~`, plus pre-release gating |
| `devkit.cron` | Five-field cron parser with lists, ranges, steps, month/weekday names, Vixie DOM/DOW semantics, and next-run search with a five-year limit |
| `devkit.duration` | Strict ISO 8601 duration parsing, canonical formatting, and datetime addition with month-end clamping followed by exact elapsed time |
| `devkit.table` | Markdown table formatting with escaping, alignment, width calculation, and a tolerant parser that recovers alignments |
| `devkit.ini` | Section/key parsing, continuations, `ParseError` line numbers, recursive interpolation, cross-section references, `$$` escaping, and cycle detection |

Verification was run on Python 3.9.6: the independent cross-module suite and all subagent test suites pass, and every module compiles cleanly. Only the five module files were changed; no extra files were added to the project.
